full_prompt_en: A square polished editorial cartoon shows two businessmen facing each other before a tall ornate white door. On the left, a huge broad man fills most of the vertical space. He wears a charcoal pinstripe three piece suit with a white shirt and black bow tie, and his hands are tucked firmly into his coat pockets. His small dark hair and glasses sit above a heavy forward leaning face as he looks down at the other man. On the right, a much shorter elderly man stands in a loose teal coat and matching trousers, holding a brown leather briefcase in one hand. His head is narrow and elongated, with pale blue hair, a prominent nose, and his chin lifted toward the larger figure. A tied tan money sack rests on the floor between them, slightly closer to the older man. The carved rectangular door behind them has inset panels and decorative flourishes near the top; the rest of the background remains plain warm white. Soft shadows fall to the floor and faintly behind the figures, anchoring them without adding a detailed room. The cartoon's humor comes from the enormous contrast in body size and stance, emphasized by clear silhouettes and sparing props. Smooth digital shading rounds the faces and coats, while selected dark outlines sharpen eyebrows, cuffs, and bag edges. The composition feels neat, restrained, and quietly confrontational, with all attention held on the unequal exchange in front of the door.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形精致编辑漫画描绘两位商人在一扇高大的雕花白门前相对而立。左侧，一名体格巨大的男子占满大部分高度。他穿炭灰细条纹三件套、白衬衫和黑领结，双手坚定地插在外套口袋里。小片深发和眼镜压在厚重前倾的脸上，他低头看着另一人。右侧，一名矮小年长男子穿宽松深青外套和同色长裤，一手拎棕色皮公文包。他的头窄而修长，留浅蓝头发、突出的鼻子，下巴抬起朝向大个子。一个扎口浅棕钱袋放在两人之间地上，稍靠近年长男子。身后雕刻矩形门带内嵌面板和上部装饰花纹；其余背景保持纯净暖白。柔和影子落在地上，并淡淡投在人物身后，使其站稳却不添加复杂房间。幽默来自体格和姿态的巨大反差，由清楚剪影与节约道具强调。平滑数字阴影使脸与外套圆润，选定深色轮廓则锐化眉毛、袖口与包边。构图整洁、克制而暗中对峙，全部注意力留在门前不对等的交流上。
style_prompt_en: Polished editorial cartooning uses elastic proportions, clean silhouettes, and finely controlled digital shading. One broad dark mass is balanced by a much narrower vertical form, establishing a comic relationship through scale alone. A pale nearly empty background lets the contrast read immediately; a shallow decorative rectangle adds quiet structure without competing with the figures. Charcoal, teal, warm cream, and leather brown remain muted, with crisp white reserved for small highlights. Faces and surfaces are rounded by smooth gradients, while selected dark contours sharpen expression and material edges. Soft floor shadows anchor the composition, and lighting remains broad and even from above one side. Detail is concentrated on a few telling features, with the surrounding space deliberately spare. The overall effect is witty, controlled, and accessible, using exaggeration and restraint together.
style_prompt_zh: 精致编辑漫画使用富弹性的比例、清楚剪影与精细受控的数字阴影。一块宽阔深色体量与更窄的竖向形体平衡，仅凭尺度建立喜剧关系。近乎空白的浅色背景使反差立刻可读；一块浅装饰矩形提供安静结构而不争抢焦点。炭灰、深青、暖奶油白与皮革棕保持低调，清白色留给少量高光。脸部和表面由平滑渐变变圆，选定深轮廓锐化表情与材质边缘。柔和地面阴影固定构图，光从上方一侧宽广而均匀到来。细节集中在少数有力特征上，周围空间有意简洁。整体机智、受控且易读，夸张与克制共同发挥作用。
theme_en: Two exaggerated businessmen facing each other by an ornate door
theme_zh: 两位夸张造型的商人在雕花门前相对
name: Clay Bennett
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
